## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(skimr)
library(mosaic)
library(ggformula)
library(vcd)
```

#### Group 2

### Our Question

"Are SMI students more introverted than MIT students?"

### Data Analysis

## Setup
```{r}
#| label: My Panel E data
E <-  read_csv(file = "data/Panel-E_group2.csv")
E
```

```{r}
skim(E)
```

```{r}
glimpse(E)
```

```{r}
E_mod <- E |> mutate(across(where(is.character),as.factor))
glimpse(E_mod)
```

## Graphs

```{r}
E_mod |> gf_bar(~`mbti-type`, fill = ~department)
```

```{r}
E_mod |> gf_bar(~`social-orientation`, fill = ~department, position = "dodge")
```


## Statistical Tests

```{r}
#| label: Chi-square_test
mosaic::xchisq.test(`social-orientation` ~ department, data = E_mod)
```

### Conclusion

After analysis of the data, we were able to find out that SMI students are, on average, more introverted than MIT students.

#### Group 5

## Panel E - Is it easier for the students of SMI to get into a relationship than MIT?


```{r}
myPanelEData <-  read_csv(file = "data/Panel-E_group5.csv") 
```
```{r}
glimpse(myPanelEData)
inspect(myPanelEData)
skim(myPanelEData)
```

```{r}
# myPanelEData |> mutate(department = as.factor(department))
# myPanelEData |> mutate(relationship_status = as.factor(relationship_status))
myPanelEMod <- myPanelEData |> dplyr::mutate(department = as.factor(department), relationship_status = as.factor(relationship_status))
glimpse(myPanelEMod)
```


```{r}
mosaic::xchisq.test(department ~ relationship_status, data = myPanelEMod)
```

```{r}
vcd::structable(relationship_status~ department , data = myPanelEMod) |> vcd::mosaic(shade = TRUE, type = "expected", gp = shading_Friendly())
```
